race.description: Beer Carpenter Champion Trainer/Local Trainer Mdn Hcp
race.comment: NEVER KNOW (3) was in commission but missed the kick and failed to get involved on debut at Rosehill back in April. Two recent trials have been inconclusive. Not a great deal of depth to this so if there is market confidence he might be the one. ANDARNA (11) was in the money first-up over 1000m here then looked a bit one-paced over today's trip on the Illawarra Grange circuit last time. Fitter and worth another chance. WATCH ME TANGO (9) started favourite and made late ground but found one better on debut over today's journey at the Sapphire Coast recently. Trained here and looks capable of mixing it with this lot. YOUR COLOUR (10) jumped slowly and lost all chance on debut at Warwick Farm four months ago. Not seen since other than in two ordinary trials. Market the best pointer. HO ALOHA (13) has placed at six of twelve and strips fitter after filling a placing first-up from a seven-week let-up on the Canberra Acton last time.
